answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a cedar that rotates unpredictably. Every checkpoint root is anchored to a public chain and the full history replays for anyone. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the glacier expensive rather than free. Seal 1oi8y.
